name: Democratic centralism
summary: Democratic centralism is the Leninist organizing principle that combines open debate before a decision with binding, uniform execution after it. Organs are elected from below and subordinate to higher bodies; the minority yields to the majority and the individual to the organization. Communist parties and states have applied it, with critics arguing that centralism overwhelmed democracy in practice.
scope: The Leninist party principle as set out by Lenin (1906), the Comintern conditions (1920) and the CPC constitution, and as applied in the CPSU and ruling Communist states. It is an organizational doctrine, not a full political-economic programme, so most statements are inferred from the Marxist-Leninist parties that use it. Excludes non-Leninist organizations that borrow the label.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Inferred: Leninist ruling parties (Soviet, Chinese) built state-provided health systems as a socialist duty.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Inferred: a wage floor is a modest pro-worker measure, though Leninists aim at abolishing wage labor rather than reforming it.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist parties using this organizing form reject market allocation in favor of planning.

public-ownership.rationale: Parties organized on this principle, as in the Comintern program, aim at socialized ownership of the commanding heights.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Inferred: taxing property-owning classes fits the Leninist program of curbing the bourgeoisie.

unions-good.rationale: Inferred: Communist parties treat unions as mass organizations or 'transmission belts' under party guidance, so support is real but conditional.

property-fundamental.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists treat private property in the means of production as something to abolish, not protect.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Inferred: regulation is acceptable but falls short of the socialization the parties seek.

cut-welfare.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states expanded social provision; cutting it conflicts with their program.

worker-ownership.rationale: Inferred: aims at social ownership, usually state-led, rather than enterprise-level worker ownership.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties accepted illegal work and also security-state vigilance over internal enemies when in power.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Inferred: ruling Communist parties generally kept drug bans; the principle itself is silent.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states restricted speech that threatened order and routinely banned racist propaganda.

strong-leader.rationale: The principle stresses collective leadership; Deng Xiaoping and others criticized one-man direction as a distortion of it.

state-harmful.rationale: Democratic centralism is meant to be applied to the state as well as the party (Lenin, 1913), so the state is a tool to be used, not abolished.

limit-guns.rationale: Inferred: ruling Leninist parties restricted private arms while the party commanded the armed forces.

empower-police-military.rationale: Inferred: Communist states backed strong security organs, with the military under party control.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Inferred: Communist parties in power generally treated prostitution as an exploitative survival of the old order.

decide-locally.rationale: Centralism is half the name: higher-level decisions bind lower organs, and the whole party is subordinate to the Central Committee.

rehabilitation.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist penal doctrine emphasizes re-education, though used alongside harsh punishment.

traditional-family.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists criticize the bourgeois family, though ruling parties often turned conservative on family policy.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Inferred: historically hostile in Leninist states, more varied among modern adherents, so genuinely split.

abortion-legal.rationale: Inferred: the Soviet Union legalized abortion early and Communist parties mostly supported it.

more-religion-public.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist parties require atheism-oriented separation and curb religion in public life.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties supported anti-racism and anti-colonial equality as part of class politics.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Inferred: Marxist tradition explains gender roles by social and economic relations.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Inferred: Leninists favor national culture 'socialist in content' yet suspect nationalism; adherents are split.

gradual-change.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties aim at revolutionary transformation, not respect for inherited institutions.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Inferred: internationalist outlook makes restriction of immigration unattractive, though states applied controls.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Inferred: the Comintern demanded centralism within the Communist movement, but a UN-style body of mixed states is not a Leninist goal.

free-trade.rationale: Inferred: Leninist theory views free trade as serving capitalist powers; ruling parties used state-controlled foreign trade.

nation-first.rationale: Inferred: proletarian internationalism pulls one way and defense of the socialist state the other.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Inferred: Leninists distrust Western intervention as imperialism.

open-borders.rationale: Inferred: internationalism favors it as an eventual goal, but ruling parties kept strict borders.

limit-growth.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist states pursued rapid growth and industrialization.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Inferred: central direction suits large-scale state action, and modern Communist parties endorse climate programs.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists prize scientific-technical progress as a base for socialism.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Inferred: Soviet and Chinese state planning embraced nuclear power.

revolution-justified.rationale: The Comintern conditions required communists to prepare for revolutionary seizure of power, including illegal organization.

experts-over-public.rationale: Inferred: cadre systems value trained officials, but the party claims to represent the masses.

central-planning.rationale: Parties built on this principle took central planning as the socialist economic model; centralism was the political counterpart.

socialized-markets.rationale: Inferred: adherents split between orthodox planning and market socialism, as in China.

land-value-tax.rationale: Inferred: a Georgist single tax is a reformist alternative to socialization.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inferred: curbing inherited wealth fits the socialist program.

basic-income.rationale: Inferred: no stated view; Leninists favor work-based entitlement but also social provision.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Inferred: socialist states shielded their industry through state control of foreign trade.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Directing investment is the core of the state planning that Leninist parties exercised.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Inferred: Leninists prefer collective or state ownership to dispersed small proprietors.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Inferred: abolition is the long-term communist aim, though not a near-term policy.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states nationalized banking and centralized credit.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Inferred: Leninists oppose class collaboration, though party-led unions resemble state bodies.

one-party-rule.rationale: Communist parties using this principle claim leadership of the state, as the CPC constitution requires state organs and army to accept party leadership; the principle itself governs the party only.

democracy-best.rationale: Adherents claim to be democratic in a substantive sense while rejecting multiparty liberal democracy, so they are split on the statement as worded.

direct-votes.rationale: Inferred: democracy within the party is by delegates and elected organs, not direct plebiscites.

workers-councils.rationale: Inferred: soviets were central to the early Bolshevik state, though the party came to control them.

right-to-secede.rationale: Inferred: Lenin affirmed self-determination in principle while the party centralized in practice; adherents split.

natural-rulers.rationale: Inferred: Marxists reject natural hierarchy, though they accept vanguard leadership.

political-violence-never.rationale: Leninist doctrine and the Comintern conditions envisage armed struggle and civil war.

war-builds-character.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists do not hold this view.

separate-church-state.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties require strict separation and state secularism.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Inferred: Leninists want these as state functions.

military-superiority.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states pursued strong defense under party command.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Inferred: internationalism rejects ethnic nationhood as a basis of the state.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Parties using the principle are Marxist-Leninist and take class struggle as the engine of history.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Inferred: socialism aims at equality but the first stage pays by work.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Inferred: no stated view; collective land ownership by the state conflicts with this.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Inferred: Leninists condemn colonialism as imperialism.

civilizational-union.rationale: Inferred: Communist internationalism is class-based, not civilizational.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Inferred: socialist ethics place the collective over self-interest.

duties-before-rights.rationale: The principle subordinates the individual to the organization and the minority to the majority.

limit-population.rationale: Inferred: split; Soviet policy was natalist and Chinese policy restrictive.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists regard industrialization as the basis of socialism.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Inferred: pro-technology but institution-minded, so split.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Inferred: no stated view; planners have been interested in computation but party leadership is primary.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Inferred: security-minded Communist states restrict encryption, although clandestine parties used secrecy.

restore-past-order.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists are progressive and see history moving toward socialism.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties insist on the correct ideology, though Deng's pragmatism splits adherents.

direct-action.rationale: Inferred: the Comintern conditions combined legal and illegal work including parliament, while stressing party leadership.

means-match-ends.rationale: Inferred: Leninists defend disciplined centralist means for a freer end.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: Inferred: abolition is a distant Marxist aim but not a policy.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists accept the formula for the higher stage of communism.

production-for-use.rationale: Inferred: socialist planning is defined against production for profit.

profit-exploitation.rationale: The Marxist-Leninist parties using this form hold the theory of surplus value.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The Comintern's conditions and Zinoviev's theses build the party for the proletarian dictatorship.

collective-farming.rationale: Inferred: Soviet and early Chinese practice, though later reformed in China.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: Inferred: Leninist theory of imperialism holds this.

harm-principle.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states restricted conduct for socialist order, beyond harm to others.

individual-rights-only.rationale: The principle subordinates the individual to the collective organization.

conscription.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states used conscription and the CPC constitution places the army under party leadership.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Inferred: opposite of the Leninist concern with collective political power.

positive-liberty.rationale: Inferred: socialists tie freedom to material means.

media-academia-power.rationale: Inferred: Leninists locate power in classes and the party, not in media or universities.

organic-representation.rationale: Inferred: Leninists reject corporatist representation in favor of party and class organs.

total-state.rationale: Inferred: Communist states directed economy and culture, but the withering-away theory complicates it.

national-rebirth.rationale: Inferred: a fascist theme foreign to Marxist-Leninist progress narratives.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Inferred: officially anti-imperialist, though Soviet practice differed.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Inferred: rejects feudal personal loyalty; authority rests on party organs.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists see ideology as class-bound but claim their science is objective; split.

universal-morality.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists treat morality as class-determined.

single-common-good.rationale: Inferred: claims to serve the proletariat's interest as the general interest, but sees class conflict.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Inferred: Leninists historically opposed Zionism, although the USSR backed Israel in 1948.

workplace-democracy.rationale: Inferred: Leninists favor worker participation but under party guidance.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Inferred: state planning does not follow balanced-budget rules.

economic-freedom.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninists reject the liberal link of political and economic freedom.

rule-by-example.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties rely on discipline and enforcement organs, not example alone.

national-self-determination.rationale: Inferred: Lenin endorsed national self-determination as a principle.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Inferred: internationalism pulls against restriction, state practice differed.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Inferred: 'he who does not work shall not eat' is a socialist principle.

class-collaboration.rationale: The Comintern conditions demand break with reformists and class collaboration.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: Inferred: opposed to Futurist destruction of heritage; Soviet museums were preserved.

dominated-front.rationale: Inferred: anti-imperialist front is an old Comintern theme but this is not core.

workers-nation.rationale: The Comintern required centralization on an international scale and internationalist class organization.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Inferred: formal equality of the sexes is Marxist-Leninist doctrine.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist doctrine holds all peoples equal, so legal racial separation is rejected.

state-class-instrument.rationale: The Marxist-Leninist theory of the state; the party seeks to turn it into an instrument of the working class.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Inferred: no stated view; Communist states have both expanded fossil fuels and green energy.

elite-replacement.rationale: Inferred: a conspiracy theory outside Marxist-Leninist analysis.

proportional-representation.rationale: Inferred: representation is through elected hierarchy, with no stated view on party-list PR.

national-mission.rationale: Inferred: Leninist internationalism has its own mission of world revolution, not national.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Inferred: Marxists acknowledge women's oppression tied to class society.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Inferred: party criticizes bourgeois elites but not its own cadres; split.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Inferred: eugenic coercion contradicts the materialist, egalitarian doctrine of the parties that use this principle.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Inferred: party control of security organs means accountability runs through the party.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Inferred: a minimal state conflicts with the planning and party-led state these parties build.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist egalitarianism rejects racial hierarchy and any discouragement of mixed marriage.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Inferred: formal equality accepted but the class-based treatment of enemies complicates it.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Inferred: the Comintern held the world party view yet Stalinist parties built socialism in one country; split.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Inferred: secular equality before the law.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Inferred: Communist states restrict proselytism but a dedicated conversion ban is not doctrine.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Inferred: a religious-cultural ban has no basis in Marxist-Leninist materialism or policy.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Stalin's doctrine adopted by ruling parties; centralism strengthened the state under hostile encirclement.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Inferred: claims legitimacy from representing the working class, not from consent as liberals mean it.

population-transfer.rationale: Inferred: rejected in principle although Soviet deportations occurred.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Inferred: Communist states ban parties opposing the socialist order; the 1921 faction ban shows this logic internally.

separated-powers.rationale: Soviet and Chinese systems concentrate power in people's congresses led by the party, as Liu Shaoqi said of China's 'centralized' state power.

vanguard-party.rationale: Democratic centralism is the organizing principle of the Leninist vanguard party, and Zinoviev's theses demand a rigidly disciplined, centralized party.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Inferred: opposed to privatizing public housing.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states restricted strikes yet in capitalist states communists support them; split.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Inferred: Marxists attribute poverty to social institutions.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Inferred: Leninist nationalities policy treats diversity as compatible with a united socialist state.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Offices are filled by elected and appointed cadres through institutional channels, not lot.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties accepted emergency measures against internal enemies.

party-controls-media.rationale: Ruling parties applying the principle put press under party direction; Lenin's 1906 position allows free debate within programme limits but not public breaking of party action.

party-commands-army.rationale: The CPC constitution says the army and militia must accept the centralised leadership of the Party.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Inferred: Paris Commune-derived Leninist principle of officials on workers' wages.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Lenin's rule is full freedom of criticism but unity of action once the party decides, and the CPC constitution makes minority subordinate to majority.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Inferred: opposed to the EU as a capitalist project, though the Comintern was a supranational centralist body.

head-commands-forces.rationale: The party and collective bodies, not a head of state, command; collective leadership is a principle.

clerical-rule.rationale: Inferred: rule by religious scholars contradicts atheist materialism and party leadership of the state.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Inferred: Lenin's revolutionary defeatism in the First World War.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Inferred: Communist states did censor art on ideological grounds, though not about virtue; split.

recall-officials.rationale: Recall of elected officials by electors is part of the principle's application to the state, as in the 1977 Soviet constitution.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Inferred: Communist states joined alliances like the Warsaw Pact.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Inferred: Communist states used public rental housing.

people-in-arms.rationale: Inferred: Marxists favored arming workers in revolution, while ruling parties built regular armies.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Inferred: Marxists criticized 'rural idiocy' and favored industrial development.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Inferred: Communist parties on both sides of Korea and Vietnam pursued reunification, others not.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Inferred: Leninism values intellectuals as party cadres.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Inferred: officially all peoples are equal.

death-penalty.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states used the death penalty, notably China.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Inferred: socialist education includes gender equality.

minority-language-support.rationale: Inferred: Leninist nationalities policy supported minority languages.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Inferred: single law for all, secular.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Inferred: Leninists emphasize discipline and conformity to collective decisions.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Inferred: Chinese amendment of 2018 versus Deng's term limits show adherents split.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Inferred: Bolsheviks dissolved the 1918 Constituent Assembly in favor of soviets.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Inferred: Communist states have justified discipline for development.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties favor collective leadership chosen via the hierarchy.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Inferred: Leninist states ran money through the state bank under party direction (Gosbank), so an independent price-stability bank cuts against the principle of party leadership of all state organs.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Inferred: the doctrine says nothing on borders, and Lenin himself ceded territory for peace at Brest-Litovsk, so adherents lean against a rule that land is never traded.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist parties treat property as subordinate to society and collective ownership as the goal, though they go further than a trust model.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties that use democratic centralism describe the USSR as a socialist state, and the state-capitalist reading comes from their left critics.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Inferred: Leninist ruling parties favour state planning and regulation, so precautionary state action fits, but the doctrine does not address it.

collective-defense.rationale: Inferred: ruling Communist states built alliances such as the Warsaw Pact, though the doctrine itself is organizational.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: Adherents split: ruling parties annexed territory by force at times, yet claim anti-imperialist principles; the doctrine is silent.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties placed religious bodies under state control and confiscated church property as a matter of course.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Inferred: in ruling Communist states the head of state is a party leader, since the party leads all state organs.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Inferred: ruling Leninist parties kept states unitary and centralized, and the CPC constitution makes the party lead state organs and army.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Inferred: centralism subordinates lower bodies to higher ones, which cuts against distinct regional systems.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Inferred: Marxist-Leninist materialism and state atheism reject divine rulers.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties favour progressive taxation as a lever on class inequality.

character-from-environment.rationale: Inferred: Marxist materialism holds that social conditions shape consciousness, so changing circumstances remakes people.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Adherents split: formal socialist legality exists, yet the party stands above state organs in the CPC constitution.

space-expansion.rationale: Inferred: Soviet-era Communist states made space exploration a showpiece of socialist progress.

mixed-constitution.rationale: Inferred: Leninist soviet power rejects balancing elites against the people and separation of powers.

leader-cult.rationale: Inferred: the principle formally calls for collective leadership, though ruling parties often developed leader cults, so adherents lean against.

equal-parenting.rationale: Not addressed by the doctrine; inferred adherents have no common line.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties differ, with Maoist-influenced ones stressing continuing class struggle; Soviet practice stressed party unity.

land-redistribution.rationale: Inferred: Leninist ruling parties carried out land reform in the USSR and China.

refugee-return.rationale: No documented position; the doctrine is organisational.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties prioritise class over nationality.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties are secular and treat religion as a private matter or an obstacle.

women-must-cover.rationale: Inferred: Leninist ruling parties promoted secular dress and women's mobilisation.

common-currency.rationale: No documented position; ruling parties used national currencies, and the doctrine is organisational.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Inferred: the Comintern stressed class internationalism over kinship of peoples.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Inferred: Leninist parties opposed national-cultural autonomy as a separate national organisation.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: Inferred: Comintern parties were told to organise where they live, in one centralised party per country.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Marxism-Leninism is built on historical materialism.

ban-cartels.rationale: Inferred: ruling parties directed the economy by state planning, not by competition law.

no-bailouts.rationale: No documented position; the doctrine is organisational.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: Party leads state organs, so courts and bodies are subordinate to party and state decisions; inferred.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Inferred: ruling parties such as the CPC and CPSU set quotas for women's representation.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Inferred: socialism in one country and the Soviet bloc economies used a largely closed trading system.

moral-incentives.rationale: Inferred: ruling parties promoted socialist emulation and moral appeals alongside material pay.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Comintern conditions required illegal work and preparation for revolution under a disciplined vanguard.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Inferred: ruling Leninist parties abolished noble titles and class privileges.

history-own-civilization.rationale: The principle is organisational and silent on curricula; ruling parties differ, with Soviet and Chinese practice emphasising national history and class history in different periods.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: The Comintern conditions require support for colonial liberation movements and condemn imperialist rule.

patriotic-education.rationale: Inferred from ruling parties that applied the principle, which promoted patriotic education; the principle itself is silent.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Inferred from Soviet nationality policy of promoting minorities, which was a form of preference; the principle itself is silent.

public-money-creation.rationale: Inferred: Leninist ruling parties put banking and credit under state control.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Leninism holds capitalism in its imperialist stage heads to general crisis, a premise of the Comintern conditions.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Leninist states pursued influence over former imperial lands while also condemning imperialism; adherents split.

delink-world-market.rationale: Soviet practice was autarkic while the CPC later chose integration; the principle itself is silent.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Lenin and the Comintern held that imperialist super-profits corrupted a layer of workers; inferred as the Leninist position.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Inferred: ruling Leninist parties subordinated private property and mandated equal treatment by law.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: The CPC constitution places party leadership over state organs, so an entrenched bill of rights limiting the state is not part of the doctrine; inferred.

missingStatements.text: Once a party has adopted a decision, no member may publicly campaign against it, though criticism beforehand should be free.
missingStatements.rationale: Lenin's 1906 rule of universal freedom of criticism provided it does not disturb unity of a definite action.

missingStatements.text: Political parties should be organized as a hierarchy in which lower bodies are bound by the decisions of higher bodies.
missingStatements.rationale: The CPC constitution and the principle's pyramid structure subordinate lower levels to higher ones.

notes: Critics, including Deng Xiaoping (1980), held that centralism overwhelmed democracy in practice. Yugoslavia in 1974 and non-Leninist users of the term would answer many items differently.
